surface: The grid in its default navigation mode (headers not navigable, Tab moving between cells): Tab in from the page, arrows across cells with their headers, Tab out at both ends and back in.

steps.note: Tab from the page's control before the grid enters the grid on its first cell.
The cell to the right, which the column header names: with headers not navigable, a reader hears the header only through the cell.
End moves to the last cell of the row, where Tab leaves the grid.
Tab from a row's last cell leaves the grid for the page's next control: no trap at the grid's end.
Shift+Tab from the page returns into the grid on the cell it left.
Home moves to the first cell of the row, where Shift+Tab leaves the grid.
Shift+Tab from a row's first cell leaves the grid for the page's previous control: no trap at the grid's start.
Tab from the page returns into the grid on the cell it left.
